# Codes CI builds and checks. `CODE [option ...]` = valid (built, then every dimension checked); `!CODE  # why` = must be rejected with a message.

!E-LBHG12-30  # centre height 30 is not offered for dr 12 (15, 20, 25)
!E-LBHG30-25  # centre height 25 is not offered for dr 30 (30, 40, 50)
!E-LBHG12  # the centre height option is part of the code
!E-LBHGW16-15  # centre height 15 is not offered for dr 16
!E-LBHG10-15  # dr 10 is not a catalogue size
!E-LBHG12-15-P  # no dowel holes on the centre-hole-height types
